verses.text: The LORD reigns! Let the whole earth celebrate! Let all the islands be glad!
Clouds and darkness surround him. Righteousness and justice hold up his throne.
Fire goes ahead of him and burns up his enemies on every side.
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees it and shakes.
Mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of the whole earth.
The skies tell of his righteousness. Every people has seen his glory.
Let everyone who serves carved images and brags about their idols be put to shame. Worship him, all you gods!
Zion heard and celebrated. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
LORD, you are Most High over all the earth. You stand far above every god.
If you love the LORD, hate evil! He guards the lives of his faithful people and pulls them out of the grip of the wicked.
Light is planted for those who do right, and joy for those with honest hearts.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy name.
